subject: Re: Onsite week conflict — demo coverage & handoff
body:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Mehta <p.meh@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week conflict — demo coverage & handoff

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the flexibility. Quick update from our side: our director of IT has pulled the exec team meetings into the afternoon of May 6 and 7 — Priyanka and I are still traveling, but availability windows have narrowed. We were hoping to keep the full product walkthrough you proposed (90 minutes) while we are on-site, but with the itinerary compressing we may only have a 30–45 minute slot on Thursday morning (May 6) before the leadership prep.

Two asks:
- Can you run a condensed, decision-oriented walk-through in ~35 minutes that focuses on inference performance, security controls (VPC/KMS), and rollout/rollback options?
- If you can only do the full 90 min in a different week, can we have an SE-led technical sync for ~30 minutes during the trip instead and schedule the deep demo later?

I've attached our travel itinerary so you can see the windows. If those short windows work, we can confirm time. Otherwise, we should plan for a handoff (SE short readout + follow-up full demo).

Thanks —
Sanjay
Director, Platform Engineering
Aurora Health Systems

Attachment: Aurora_Itinerary_May2026.pdf (application/pdf, 234 KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Priyanka Mehta <p.meh@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 18:40:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite week — proposed demo schedule and SE coverage

Hi Sanjay / Priyanka,

Great to hear you'll be in SF — excited to meet the team in person. Based on the agenda you sent, we penciled a 90-minute product demo + Q&A on Thursday, May 6 at 10:00 AM PT (location: Aurora HQ conference B). Agenda draft:
- 10m: Introductions & goals
- 30m: Redwood architecture & hosting options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- 30m: Live inference demo + latency/cost walkthrough (batching/caching examples)
- 15m: Rollout patterns, security/compliance (KMS, VPC, audit logs)
- 5m: Next steps / mutual action items

If you think you won't have that long, happy to cut the agenda and prioritize the bits that matter. If May 6 is impossible, we can either:
1) do a ~30 min SE-led technical sync during your trip to cover the infra/security details and schedule the full demo the following week, or
2) keep the 90 min but move to an alternate date the week after.

Attaching an updated mutual action plan and the meeting invite. Let me know what you prefer and I'll coordinate calendars / send an updated calendar event.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 48 KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aurorahealth.com>, Priyanka Mehta <p.meh@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — proposed demo schedule and SE coverage

Monica / Dylan — heads up from procurement: Aurora asked if we can share a short (20–30 min) SE deep-dive on quantization/latency profiling while they're in town; they also flagged interest in the Dedicated offering for predictable throughput.

Dylan: can you run a technical session on Thu May 6 at 9:15 AM PT (30 min)? We'll follow with the decision-oriented 35 min product summary at 10:00 for the execs if that works. If the exec schedule collapses earlier, we should be able to consolidate into a single 45-minute slot at 9:15.

Monica: please hold both slots on the calendar and I'll confirm once I hear back from Priyanka / Sanjay with final windows.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Director — Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyanka Mehta <p.meh@aurorahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — proposed demo schedule and SE coverage

Monica / Aditya / Dylan,

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the flexible options — the condensed plan works best for us. We can do Dylan's SE deep-dive at 9:15 AM PT on May 6 for ~30 minutes (focused on latency profiling and quantization trade-offs), followed immediately by Monica's 35-minute exec-oriented summary at 10:00 AM PT. That gives us the technical details and the decision framing before the leadership prep.

Please send updated calendar invites (SE session + exec summary) and any one-pager or short slide deck we can distribute to the execs prior to the meetings. We'll bring a small AV cart for the demo.

See you next week —
Priyanka
VP, Technology Operations
Aurora Health Systems

Attachment: none
